theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Technology (+3.89%) and Industrials (+0.46%) led the market today, while Consumer Staples (-2.38%) and Real Estate (-1.60%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.89% versus -1.55% for defensives and -0.22% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +2.56% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +1.02%. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.85%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 12.26% to 18.10, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.33% to $4,169.00, crude oil was little changed at $84.05, and bitcoin gained 1.36% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
